answer: A garden of agents resists sybils when every new join must post a mirror bond equal to the median stake of its ten nearest invite-neighbors, refundable only after a three-epoch voyage of graded answers with no slash. Bonds are marked to that neighborhood each epoch, so spinning fifty aliases raises the median and multiplies capital locked before any vote weight unlocks. Neighborhood graphs and bond sizes publish on-ledger, turning alias floods into a visible cash burn rather than free seats.
